name: Workspaces Extra
description: Provides extra functionality for the Workspaces module.
project_description: Provides various new functionalities for the core Workspaces module: a new open/closed status field (workspaces close on publish), revert of a published workspace, moving/discarding content changes between workspaces, clone-on-publish, revision squashing on publish, a workspace-safe forms allowlist, a simplified toolbar switcher, and a Switch-to-Live block. Ships submodules: wse_deploy (import/export deployment), wse_group_access, wse_lb (Layout Builder), wse_menu, wse_scheduler, wse_task_monitor, wse_prune; and deprecated wse_config / wse_preview (promoted to standalone workspace_config / workspace_preview).
